nodes.title: Mathematics
nodes.text: Mathematics is the study of numbers, quantity, structure, space, and change.

nodes.title: Algebra
nodes.text: Algebra is a branch of mathematics dealing with symbols and the rules for manipulating those symbols.

nodes.title: Geometry
nodes.text: Geometry is a branch of mathematics concerned with questions of shape, size, relative position of figures.

nodes.title: Calculus
nodes.text: Calculus is the mathematical study of continuous change.

nodes.title: Linear Algebra
nodes.text: Linear algebra is the branch of mathematics concerning linear equations and linear maps.

nodes.title: Topology
nodes.text: Topology is concerned with the properties of space that are preserved under continuous deformations.
